experiment: frequency-resolved phase probe of saved encoder checkpoints
question: Does the frozen E preserve per-bin inter-sensor phase, or did the previous 512-feature readout lose it?

geometry.note: nominal training geometry; not the measured field geometry

variants.clean10: fit on probe at 10 dB, target clean-D cross-phase; primary
variants.cleanrand: fit on probe at random SNR 0..20 dB, target clean-D cross-phase; comparability with the old probe
variants.obs10: fit on probe at 10 dB, target observed-X cross-phase; observed-only control
variants.raw_clean10: enc=None, fit at 10 dB, target clean-D cross-phase; reference only

readout.feature: cross[:, f] of encoded channels: C x C = 256 features per pair/bin (raw C=2 -> 4)
readout.target: [cos(phi), sin(phi)] of the mean-over-T cross-spectrum at each bin
readout.regression: ridge b.probe_fit, coefficient .01, fit on probe 8103
readout.tdoa: grid search tau in [-130,130] us, step 0.25 us, maximize |mean_f exp(j(phi_hat + 2*pi*f*tau))|, parabolic refine
readout.u: OLS slope of tau_ij over (i-j), u_hat = slope*c/d/1e6
readout.pairs: k1 = 7 adjacent pairs; k7 = all 28 pairs

primary_metric: median theta_deg from k1 at 10 dB, clean10 variant, per model x seed

decision_rule.E_preserves_phase: clean10 k1 median theta <= 0.2-0.3 deg for >=2/3 seeds (within 2-3x of raw 0.11 deg)
decision_rule.readout_still_weak: worse than the previous k1 0.78 deg; try low-rank/1D-conv over frequency

checks: per-bin feature at bin 21 equals the old 12 kHz feature
noiseless clean-D phase grid recovers tau to 0.01 us and u to 1e-6
git status clean and validator PASS after run
limits: stationary multitone, single path, nominal d=0.027 and c=1500
CPU float32; not bitwise identical to CUDA
3 seeds are repeated trainings, not independent environments
clean-D target is a declared diagnostic access; observed-X variant is reported separately
per-bin linear readout may be capacity-limited; failure limits the tested readout, not all possible readouts
